visualCharacteristics.description: N columns per row (columns-N-cols class added); stacked on mobile with image columns first, side by side from 900px. A column holding a Vidyard link (play.vidyard.com/{uuid}), optionally with a poster image above it, renders a 16:9 poster with a play overlay; clicking swaps in the inline Vidyard player. Without a poster the Vidyard thumbnail is used.

contentPattern.structure: Columns/rows grid authored in UE (column filter: text, image, button, title). Each cell is rich content. Video cell: optional poster image + a paragraph whose only content is a link to play.vidyard.com/{uuid} (link text = video title, used as the accessible label).

usage.description: Footer (link columns); Host Response to Infection (text + image split); Remote Services and Diagnostics (IntelliServe text + Vidyard video).

reuseGuidance: Use for generic side-by-side text/media splits, including text beside an inline Vidyard video. Use content-reversed for the image-left feature split, and cards-grid video for a grid of several video posters.
